recognize_zh: 大腸癌接受 oxaliplatin/5-FU 化療 6 年後出現：周邊血可見有核紅血球與大型不典型細胞、骨髓抹片充滿大型且核形不規則／多核的紅血球前驅細胞（dyserythropoiesis），加上複雜核型（D），符合治療相關骨髓分化不良症候群（therapy-related MDS）合併複雜染色體異常。
features: Panel A (PB): circulating nucleated red cells and a larger immature cell with irregular nucleus; anisopoikilocytosis
Panels B-C (BM aspirate): numerous erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and megaloblastoid chromatin
Large bizarre/multinucleated erythroid precursors with nuclear irregularity (panel C and inset)
Dysplastic granulocytic forms with abnormal nuclear segmentation in the background
Panel D: G-banded karyotype with multiple numerical and structural abnormalities (complex karyotype)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with circulating nucleated red cells and occasional large immature mononuclear cells. The bone marrow aspirate is cellular with a prominent erythroid population showing marked dyserythropoiesis, including megaloblastoid maturation, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, nuclear irregularity, and large multinucleated forms; dysplastic granulocytes are also present. The accompanying G-banded karyotype shows multiple numerical and structural abnormalities, although chromosome-level detail is limited at this resolution. The blast percentage cannot be reliably estimated from these fields. In a patient with prior oxaliplatin/fluorouracil exposure, findings are consistent with a therapy-related myelodysplastic neoplasm with complex karyotype; erythroid-predominant AML should be excluded by a formal differential count.

ddx.vs: Requires >80% erythroid precursors with >=30% proerythroblasts on a formal count, which cannot be established from selected fields and would reclassify the case.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils but a normal karyotype and response to vitamin replacement.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic cells that are cytokeratin/CDX2 positive, unlike the discohesive erythroid precursors here.

ddx.dx: Toxic dyserythropoiesis from chemotherapy or alcohol
ddx.vs: Transient drug-related dysplasia lacks a clonal complex karyotype and resolves after the exposure is removed.
